mapper.sql: app.application_id, app.announcement_id, a.title AS announcement_title, app.company_user_id, u.company_name, u.business_no, app.project_name, app.total_budget, app.request_grant, app.self_funding, app.summary, app.plan_file_id, f.original_name AS plan_file_name, app.status, c.code_name AS status_name, app.submitted_at, app.created_at, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(e.total_score), 1) FROM evaluation e WHERE e.application_id = app.application_id AND e.status = 'COMPLETED') AS avg_score

FROM application app INNER JOIN announcement a ON app.announcement_id = a.announcement_id INNER JOIN users u ON app.company_user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN com_code_detail c ON app.status = c.code_id AND c.group_id = 'APP_STATUS' LEFT JOIN com_file f ON app.plan_file_id = f.file_id

where.if: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM evaluation ev WHERE ev.application_id = app.application_id AND ev.evaluator_user_id = #{evaluatorUserId})
AND (app.project_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.company_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM application app INNER JOIN users u ON app.company_user_id = u.user_id
SELECT application_id, company_user_id, request_grant, status FROM application WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM application WHERE status = 'SELECTED'
